summary: v52k — Institutions pause to changes_requested while change requests are pending and auto-restore to approved when the queue clears; admin pipeline shows pending-count badges and a changes-pending filter; Current/Proposed diff boxes render human-readable values on a pinned light palette (fixes dark-on-hover/dark JSON boxes); owner invite form gains multi-row '+ Add another teammate' and a country dial dropdown with per-country digit validation, backed by a server-side international-format check.

verification.status_roundtrip: create -> changes_requested(previous=approved); approve 1 of 2 pending -> still paused; cancel last -> approved; reject path -> approved.
verification.admin_list: GET /escrow-institutions?status=changes_requested returns 200 and pending_changes=1 on the seeded row.
verification.invite_phone: raw digits 454545454 -> 422; '+971 501234567' -> 200 when approved; 403 while paused (intended gating).
verification.invite_ui: add-row renders escrow-invite-row-1; country select has 30 options; remove works; bad phone shows 'United Arab Emirates phone numbers must be exactly 9 digits (you entered 3)' toast (screenshot iteration_79_invite2.png).
verification.admin_diff_ui: no raw JSON braces in change panel; friendly value 'Abu Dhabi' visible; diff box background computed as rgb(248,250,252) light slate (screenshot iteration_79_admin_diff.png).
